request.description: Asks to send the file to the lender of an `eligible` result from the latest match run. The application must be `assessed` (it moves to `ready_for_submission`), `ready_for_submission` or `submitted`; at most one open submission per product and five open per application. Optional `shareWithLender: true` (borrower context only, 403 `FORBIDDEN` otherwise) records the borrower's `lender_sharing` consent for this lender's organisation in the same step. The submission waits in `pending_approval` until ops approve it (lender consent and documents are checked then). States: pending_approval → approved → sent_to_lender → under_review ⇄ query_raised → sanctioned → disbursed (more tranches stay disbursed), or rejected / withdrawn. Borrower and partner contexts.
